text.en: Never give your name, school, address or photos to someone from a game or chat.
text.hg: Apna naam, school, address ya photos game ya chat wale kisi insaan ko kabhi mat do.

text.en: Ask a grown-up before you click a link, download a game or chat with someone new.
text.hg: Naya link kholne, game download karne ya kisi naye insaan se baat karne se pehle kisi bade se poochho.

label.hg: Prize ek trick ho sakta hai

text.en: Bright buttons saying 'You won!' or 'Free coins!' are often tricks.
text.hg: 'You won!' ya 'Free coins!' wale chamkeele button aksar trick hote hain.

text.en: If something makes your tummy feel funny or scared, stop and put the phone down.
text.hg: Agar kuch dekhkar pet mein ajeeb sa lage ya darr lage, toh ruk jao aur phone neeche rakh do.

text.en: Tell Mummy, Papa, Dadi or your teacher. You will not be in trouble.
text.hg: Mummy, Papa, Dadi ya teacher ko batao. Tumhe daant nahi padegi.

text.en: They are extra nice and agree with everything you say.
text.hg: Woh extra nice bante hain aur tumhari har baat mein haan mein haan milate hain.

text.en: Game coins, skins or a mobile recharge start arriving.
text.hg: Game coins, skins ya mobile recharge jaise gifts aane lagte hain.

text.en: They ask you to move to a private chat or another app.
text.hg: Woh tumhe private chat ya kisi doosre app pe shift hone ko bolte hain.

text.en: 'Do not tell your parents.' Then come requests that feel wrong, like photos or meeting alone.
text.hg: 'Mummy-papa ko mat batana.' Phir aisi demands aati hain jo galat lagein, jaise photos ya akele milna.

text.en: At any step, stop replying, keep the chat and tell a trusted adult the same day.
text.hg: Kisi bhi step pe reply band karo, chat rehne do aur usi din kisi trusted adult ko batao.

title.en: Once sent, it is out of your control
title.hg: Ek baar bhej di, toh photo tumhare haath se nikal gayi

points.en: View-once photos delete themselves, so they are safe.
points.hg: View-once photo apne aap delete ho jaati hai, isliye woh safe hai.

points.en: If I trust them, the photo will stay private.
points.hg: Agar mujhe un pe trust hai, toh photo private hi rahegi.

points.en: If I took the photo myself, it is legal.
points.hg: Agar photo maine khud li hai, toh yeh legal hai.

points.en: If you loved me, you would send one.
points.hg: Agar tum mujhse pyaar karte, toh ek photo bhej dete.

points.en: A screenshot, a second phone or a backup can keep a copy.
points.hg: Screenshot, doosra phone ya backup uski copy rakh sakta hai.

points.en: Phones get lost or hacked, and relationships can end badly.
points.hg: Phone kho jaate hain ya hack ho jaate hain, aur relationships bure tareeke se khatam ho sakte hain.

points.en: A sexual image of anyone under 18 is illegal in India, even if they took it.
points.hg: India mein under-18 kisi ki bhi sexual image illegal hai, chahe usne khud li ho.

points.en: Affection has no test. A short 'No' is enough.
points.hg: Pyaar koi test nahi leta. Ek chhota sa 'No' kaafi hai.

text.en: Every reply tells them the pressure is working.
text.hg: Har reply unhe batata hai ki unka pressure kaam kar raha hai.

label.en: Do not pay or send more
label.hg: Na pay karo, na kuch aur bhejo

text.en: Paying usually brings a bigger demand, not silence.
text.hg: Pay karne se usually chuppi nahi, aur badi demand aati hai.

label.hg: Chat rehne do, details note karo

text.en: Do not delete it. Note usernames, UPI or bank details and times, but never copy the sexual image.
text.hg: Chat delete mat karo. Usernames, UPI ya bank details aur time note karo, par sexual image ki copy kabhi mat banao.

text.en: Report in the app and on cybercrime.gov.in. Money already sent? Call 1930 quickly.
text.hg: App mein aur cybercrime.gov.in pe report karo. Paise bhej chuke ho? Turant 1930 pe call karo.

text.en: The crime is theirs, not yours. If the fear feels unbearable, call 14416 or 112.
text.hg: Crime unka hai, tumhara nahi. Agar darr bardaasht se bahar lage, toh 14416 ya 112 pe call karo.

title.en: Leaks and fakes: myth vs fact
title.hg: Leaks aur fakes: myth vs fact

points.en: If a private photo leaks, the person in it is to blame.
points.hg: Agar koi private photo leak ho jaye, toh galti photo wale insaan ki hai.

points.en: A deepfake is fake, so it is harmless.
points.hg: Deepfake toh fake hai, isliye usse koi harm nahi.

points.en: 'Revenge porn' means the person deserved it.
points.hg: 'Revenge porn' ka matlab hai ki woh insaan isi layak tha.

points.en: Sending a photo to one person lets them show others.
points.hg: Kisi ek ko photo bheji, toh use doosron ko dikhane ka haq mil gaya.

points.en: The person who shares it without consent commits the offence.
points.hg: Offence uska hai jo bina consent ke ise share karta hai.

points.en: The image is fake, but the harm is real; report it on cybercrime.gov.in.
points.hg: Image fake hai, par harm real hai; cybercrime.gov.in pe iski report karo.

points.en: It is image-based sexual abuse, and nobody deserves it.
points.hg: Yeh image-based sexual abuse hai, aur koi iske layak nahi hota.

points.en: Consent to share with one person is never consent to show anyone else.
points.hg: Ek insaan ko bhejne ka consent kisi aur ko dikhane ka consent kabhi nahi hota.

text.en: In-app reporting gets harmful content and accounts removed.
text.hg: App mein report karne se harmful content aur accounts hataye jaate hain.

text.en: Complaints about any online crime, with a section for crimes against women and children.
text.hg: Kisi bhi online crime ki complaint, aur women aur bachchon ke khilaaf crimes ke liye alag section.

text.en: The cybercrime helpline, and the fastest route when money has been taken.
text.hg: Cybercrime helpline; paise chale gaye hon toh yahi sabse fast route hai.

text.en: Child Helpline for anyone under 18 who needs help or protection.
text.hg: Child Helpline, under-18 har us insaan ke liye jise help ya protection chahiye.

text.en: 112 for emergencies and immediate danger. Women can also call 181.
text.hg: Emergency aur turant khatre mein 112. Women 181 pe bhi call kar sakti hain.

text.en: Tele-MANAS offers free counselling for the emotional weight.
text.hg: Tele-MANAS pe mann ke bojh ke liye free counselling milti hai.
